newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ARTU SHARES CONTINUE THEIR ASCENT.
newsitem.headline: ARTU SHARES CONTINUE THEIR ASCENT.

text.p: Shares in small Dutch biotechnology firm Artu Biologicals continued their recent ascent on Thursday in heavier than usual trading.
But dealers said they had heard nothing unusual in the market or from the company itself to explain the rise.
The shares were up 1.20 guilders at 10.20 this morning with bourse statistics showing over 400,000 shares changing hands.
Since October 4 trading volumes have been well in excess of averge daily volume of around 20,000 shares and the price has almost doubled from levels of just over five guilders.
Several dealers said they had heard nothing to explain the move but added that Artu was a rather illiquid stock and that even moderate buying interest could push up the share price.
